messages:
maria: Heads-up — putting together the joint SI case pack for AcmeCloud. Need final logo locks, two solution briefs (EN/FR), and hero screenshot treatments. Quick pass pls.

ev an: On it. Do we have vector lockups for Acme? I only have PNG exports.

raj: @evan partner sent an SVG but it's in their old color palette. I can forward the approved SVG from yesterday.

ev an: SG, forward please. Also quick question on badge placement — prefer bottom-left or top-right on the one-pager?

sierra: Bottom-left works for marketplace tiles; top-right better for long PDFs. Keep clearspace ~16px.

andrew: Localization note — FR and DE strings are attached. Need font fallback for diacritics: Inter + Noto Sans is fine. Also confirm CTA translations: `Get started` -> `Commencer` / `Jetzt starten`.

lucy: Legal: check Acme trademark line. They require the small-print notice: "Acme is a registered trademark of AcmeCorp." Confirm exact wording with partner. Also do not alter or recolor their logo.

maria: I'll confirm trademark wording with the partner rep (Maria H). I'll also ask for high-res SVGs and alt text for accessibility.

legal-bot: Reminder: partner T&Cs require 24–48h turn for brand approvals. Leave room for legal sign-off. :white_check_mark: 

raj: One more — marketplace listing needs a 1:1 thumbnail + 16:9 hero and light/dark variants. Evan can you export both sizes and color modes?

ev an: Yep. Will produce: `acme_tile_1x1_light.svg`, `acme_tile_1x1_dark.svg`, `acme_hero_16x9_light.png`, `acme_hero_16x9_dark.png`. Uploading to `/partnerships/acme/assets` by EOD.

sierra: For the case study copy: target 500–700 words, include two customer quotes and a short technical appendix with integration notes. I have metrics from eng-prod to pull in.

maria: Thanks — if everyone is OK I will send the bundle to Acme for final brand sign-off by 3pm PT. Any blockers?

lucy: Just confirm the trademark line before you send — otherwise looks good from legal.

andrew: Minor: use DD/MM/YYYY in FR PDF, keep MM/DD/YYYY for US, and ISO for machine-readable meta.

maria: Will update formatting rules and post the final bundle link once uploaded. :rocket:
